name: smwgraphics-smb3-styled-long-pipes
title: SMB3 Styled Long Pipes
description:
This is what the name says. This is SMB3 styled long pipes that work with FuSoYa's Screen Scrolling patch. There might be other graphics because I used Pac's SMB3 GFX patch. Also ignore the weird shapes. I kinda couldn't find how to fit them.

Mod Note

The Map16 should be found in THIS PATCH, so a .map16 is NOT included in this update.

Mod Disc Add

It works with FuSoYa's Screen
Scrolling pipes patch.

Just replace GFX17 in your SMW hack if using Fusoya's pipes.
